The source was not a mislabeled EO12107. This intermediate amendment does not itself establish final cessation of the continuing parent membership clause. EO12379 section 12 formally revokes the parent as amended; no revival of the 1959 body is asserted. Exact first cessation remains unresolved.

finding: The complete original contains THREE sections. Section 1 creates the Advisory Council and lists eight federal officers. Section 2 contains both advice/assistance to the statutory Bank board and the coordinating-forum duty. Section 3 separately requires Treasury administrative support to the extent permitted by law; the machine inventory omitted this clause. None contains an express sunset or report trigger. EO12379 section 15 expressly revokes this Council order, not the statutory Bank. Held P.L.93-224 section 4 establishes the Bank until dissolution by Congress; P.L.92-463 section 3(2) excludes committees composed wholly of full-time federal officers from FACA. Held P.L.96-88 section 509 redesignates HEW/HHS with a transferred-function exception; sections 505 and 601 require examination before assigning the membership event date. No complete claim is asserted merely because the repeal is located. The assigned provisional NO status is preserved; exact first cessation remains explicitly unresolved.
